THE_ARCHITECT.talk.FULLMOONKNIGHT-KNIGHT: Another one who walked out of some other story. Who are you?
A patrol knight. The full moon isn't over, and my town is waiting.
Then go home, Little Red. Don't keep the wolf waiting.
You again. How is your grandmother?
She asked me to tell you: get out of the way.
Your oath is more stubborn than this tower.
By the moonlight, I never break my word.
Then let us see how high the moonlight reaches.
